live horizontal rhizome, proximal 4-cm segment associated with a living short shoot; exclude vertical rhizome and roots

candidate_order.rationale: least-destructive first candidate; 9-cm Thalassia biomass cores and ~15-cm belowground coring both have field precedent
retain small diameter while extending to the common ~20-cm intact-core depth
increase footprint only if small-diameter candidates fail rhizome/dry-mass recovery
common intact Thalassia core geometry in experimental/physiological work
deeper established belowground-biomass geometry; final candidate, not default

candidate_methods: immediate liquid-nitrogen flash-freeze of cleaned target rhizome tissue, then frozen transport/storage and freeze-drying
rapid direct dry-ice freezing of cleaned target rhizome tissue, then frozen transport/storage and freeze-drying
preservation.candidate_method_order_rule: Test the operationally feasible rapid-freezing methods above against an immediate-preservation reference. Prefer the method with the shortest feasible field latency; do not add a slower chilled-only method merely to increase convenience after outcome-bearing collection begins.

decision: Do not copy pilot values into the authoritative precollection freeze until the fail-closed pilot validator reports PASS_METHOD_PILOT.

literature_backed_candidate_order.note: These are pilot candidates, not selected values. Final tissue class, core geometry and preservation method remain null until the response-independent pilot passes.
tissue_precedent: Lee & Dunton 1999: Thalassia shoot units included healthy leaves, roots and a 3-cm horizontal rhizome after 15-cm-diameter x ~20-cm cores.
Marine Technology Society 1983 chemical work: rhizome defined as a 4-cm section attached to the short shoot.
core_precedent: Lee & Dunton 1999: 15-cm diameter x ~20-cm depth intact Thalassia cores; 9-cm diameter cores for biomass sampling.
Kenworthy & Thayer 1984: 15-cm diameter x 25-cm depth for Thalassia belowground biomass.
Multiple later Thalassia studies use approximately 15-cm diameter x 20-cm depth intact cores.
preservation_precedent: General plant/seagrass NSC guidance prioritizes rapid metabolic arrest by liquid nitrogen or dry ice followed by freeze-drying.
Sørensen et al. 2018 requires species-specific preliminary testing when transferring the standardized seagrass HPLC workflow.

analytical_qc_count_freeze.rule: Counts are supplied by the receiving laboratory before pilot results are generated/inspected; each minimum must be >=1 and cannot be relaxed after results.
